newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX JGB, Euroyen dive on tankan, more falls seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX JGB, Euroyen dive on tankan, more falls seen.

text.p: SIMEX Japanese government bond (JGB) and Euroyen futures took a dive on Wednesday morning, reeling from fears of an interest rate hike after a much better-than-expected report on Japanese corporate sentiment.
Dealers said both contracts could fall further before recovering.
The Bank of Japan's "tankan" report showed confidence high among some of Japan's industrial sectors, confounding economists who had predicted a bearish outlook.
The tankan's key diffusion index for major manufacturers was plus seven, up from plus two in March and compared with economists' forecasts of minus four to plus four.
The SIMEX September JGB futures contract lost 1.40 points to stand at 123.05 by 0315 GMT, after opening at 124.90 before the report was released.
December Euroyen futures tumbled 0.13 to 99.01, down sharply from its IMM close at 99.16 on a busier than usual 25,270 lots.
Several dealers said the market appeared to have over-reacted to the unexpectedly positive tankan report.
"People are reassessing the situation in Japan," said the head of trading at a large U.S. bank.

"But one tankan doesn't make a recovery. One sector of the Japanese economy -- the export sector -- is doing well, but the domestic side is still patchy," he said. "So I don't think the Japanese government is going to raise interest rates soon."
One dealer said the fall in the Euroyen contracts -- which saw March 1998 drop 0.18 to 98.76 and June 1998 lose 0.20 to 98.54 -- priced in nearly a 50-basis point rise in Japanese interest rates.
But he said the contracts could fall further when the London LIFFE opened later.
"JGBs could lose another 30 points to, say, 122.80, and the December Euroyen could get down to 98.90 before finding real support," he said.
Eurodollar futures followed the lower trend set by Euroyen but on much lower volume. September Eurodollars stood at 94.135 at 0315 against their IMM close at 94.14 on volume of 1230 lots.
